Yes — that feels natural. My everyday search bar stays simple and just narrows as I type, so nothing's changed for the quick rummaging I do most of the time. But when I actually need to be precise, tapping "Search options" opens up the extra tools — picking a label to search within, and a checkbox to match an exact phrase — right there without sending me off to some separate screen. That's the right balance: the power's tucked away until I ask for it, so I'm never confronted with it when I just want a fast look.

And having those combine with whatever I've typed is exactly what I wanted — like "find this phrase, but only among my architecture links." Let me actually try them out — narrowing to a label and matching an exact phrase — to make sure they do what they say, and I'll compare with the other version you've got.
